item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 04/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong today. The weather will be generally fine, and warm during the day over the region. A band of clouds will cover southern China towards the weekend and early next week. There will be a few showers over the region. Winds are expected to be weak over Guangdong midweek next week. It will be rather warm during the day with coastal mist in the morning and at night. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, there will be a few showers over southern China in the latter part of next week.
